title: 10 Penny Stocks Reporting Earnings Next Week That Tickeron's AI Flags for Momentum
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Key takeaways:

* Unlike the large- and mid-cap baskets, every stock here is negative YTD — this list is built on **near-term momentum and rebound setups**, not fundamental YTD winners.
* Six of ten posted double-digit single-day gains: [NPWR](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NPWR/) \+20.37%, [AMZE](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZE/) \+18.93%, [ZSTK](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ZSTK/) \+16.31%, [HUMA](https://tickeron.com/ticker/HUMA/) \+9.96%, [ALDX](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ALDX/) \+8.33%, and [ATNM](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ATNM/) \+7.90%.
* [CRGO](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRGO/), [DCGO](https://tickeron.com/ticker/DCGO/), and [IQST](https://tickeron.com/ticker/IQST/) have confirmed earnings dates inside the Aug 17–23 window on Tickeron's calendar; the remainder are scheduled based on the broader earnings-week list.
* [CRIS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRIS/) and [AMZE](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZE/) carry the deepest YTD drawdowns in the group (-90.89% and -91.68%) — this is the highest-risk tier in the entire report; size positions accordingly.
* Tickeron's Financial Learning Models classify this basket as a speculative, high-volatility momentum trade, distinct from the technical breakout setups driving the large- and mid-cap picks above.

[**CRGO**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRGO/) **— Freightos Limited**  
CRGO trades at **$1.35** (+2.27% today), down **-41.05%** YTD, 68.16% below its $4.24 high (low: $1.14). Market cap: $0.07B. Freight-tech logistics name with a confirmed earnings date in this window and a fresh green day heading in. **30-day forecast: bullish, speculative.**

[**DCGO**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/DCGO/) **— DocGo Inc.**  
At **$0.67** (+2.17% today), DCGO is down **-23.97%** YTD, 61.42% below its $1.73 high (low: $0.45). Market cap: $0.07B. Mobile-health services name with a confirmed report date and improving daily momentum. **30-day forecast: bullish, speculative.**

[**IQST**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/IQST/) **— iQSTEL Inc.**  
IQST is at **$1.17** (-0.85% today), down **-60.20%** YTD, 84.07% below its $7.35 high (low: $0.87). Market cap: $0.01B. Telecom/fintech micro-cap with a confirmed earnings date; included as a deep-value name despite the flat day. **30-day forecast: neutral, speculative.**

[**CRIS**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRIS/) **— Curis, Inc.**  
At **$1.80** (-3.74% today), CRIS is down **-90.89%** YTD, 95.38% below its $39.00 high (low: $1.54). Market cap: $0.0035B. This is the single riskiest name in the report — a clinical-stage biotech that has collapsed nearly all year, included only for extreme earnings-week volatility ahead of its confirmed report date. **30-day forecast: bearish bias, extreme-risk speculative trade only.**

[**NPWR**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NPWR/) **— NET Power Inc.**  
NPWR is at **$1.95**, up **+20.37%** today — the single largest daily gain in the entire report — though still down **-14.10%** YTD, 62.50% below its $5.20 high (low: $1.35). Market cap: $0.17B. Clean-energy power-generation name showing the sharpest momentum signal in this basket heading into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish, speculative.**

[**ZSTK**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ZSTK/) **— Flora Growth Corp.**  
At **$1.94** (+16.31% today), ZSTK is down **-68.40%** YTD, 87.10% below its $15.04 high (low: $1.32). Market cap: $0.002B. A sharp single-day pop puts this micro-cap consumer name on Tickeron's momentum radar into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish, speculative.**

[**HUMA**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/HUMA/) **— Humacyte, Inc.**  
HUMA is at **$0.60** (+9.96% today), down **-37.03%** YTD, 76.28% below its $2.55 high (low: $0.53). Market cap: $0.10B. Bioengineered-tissue name showing a strong pre-earnings pop after a rough year. **30-day forecast: bullish, speculative.**

[**ALDX**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ALDX/) **— Aldeyra Therapeutics, Inc.**  
At **$1.56** (+8.33% today), ALDX is down **-69.88%** YTD, 74.74% below its $6.17 high (low: $1.07). Market cap: $0.09B. Clinical-stage biotech showing a sharp rebound day heading into its report. **30-day forecast: bullish, speculative.**

[**ATNM**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ATNM/) **— Actinium Pharmaceuticals, Inc.**  
ATNM is at **$1.04** (+7.90% today), down **-24.09%** YTD, 42.41% below its $1.81 high (low: $0.73). Market cap: $0.03B. Radiopharmaceutical developer with a solid pre-earnings bounce off recent lows. **30-day forecast: bullish, speculative.**

[**AMZE**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZE/) **— Amaze Holdings, Inc.**  
At **$0.24** (+18.93% today), AMZE is down **-91.68%** YTD, 99.20% below its $30.48 high (low: $0.16). Market cap: $0.0018B. The most extreme name in the report — a near-total collapse from its 52-week high, with today's outsized percentage gain reflecting the low absolute share price as much as genuine momentum. **30-day forecast: extreme-risk speculative trade only.**

[**Tickeron's AI Trading Bot**](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/)**s and Financial Learning Models:** This basket is where Tickeron's AI Trading Bots switch from breakout-proximity scoring to pure momentum detection — six of the ten names posted double-digit single-day percentage gains, which the bots' sentiment-adjusted pattern-confirmation layer treats as short-term reversal signals distinct from the steadier technical setups in the large- and mid-cap baskets above. Tickeron's Financial Learning Models (FLMs), built to detect fast-moving rotations, flag CRIS and AMZE specifically as outlier-risk names whose YTD collapse (down -90.89% and -91.68% respectively) means today's bounce should be read as a speculative trade, not a trend reversal. Traders using Tickeron's bots for this tier should expect materially higher volatility than the large- and mid-cap baskets in this report.
